description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests for toggling network device settings such as bridge mode and IGMP snooping. It includes session validation, processes POST parameters, updates device configuration via setStr calls, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration parameter on the device.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration parameter from the device.
